name: City
definition: A large human settlement, typically larger than a town or village.

name: Musical Band
definition: A group of musicians who perform together.

name: Newspaper
definition: A publication, usually issued daily or weekly, containing news, articles, advertisements, and other information.

name: Person - Athlete
definition: An individual known primarily for their participation in sports.

name: Radio Station
definition: A broadcasting service that transmits audio content via radio waves.

name: State or Province
definition: A territorial division within a country, often with its own government.

name: Government Agency or Fleet
definition: An official organization or group of vehicles/ships operated by a government.

name: Television Show
definition: A series of televised programs or episodes.

name: Sports Tournament
definition: A competitive event involving multiple sports teams or individuals.

name: Political Party or Movement
definition: An organized group seeking to influence or control government policy.

name: Sports Team
definition: An organized group of players competing together in a sport.

name: Country
definition: A nation with its own government, occupying a particular territory.

name: Military Vehicle
definition: A vehicle designed for use by armed forces.

name: Educational Institution
definition: An organization dedicated to education and learning.

name: Sports League
definition: An organization that coordinates competitions among sports teams.

name: Language
definition: A system of communication used by a particular community or country.

name: Royalty or Monarch
definition: A person belonging to a royal family or ruling as a monarch.

name: University or Academic Institution
definition: An institution of higher education and research.

name: Airport
definition: A facility where aircraft take off and land, including terminals for passengers.

name: Theatre or Performance Venue
definition: A place where live performances such as plays or concerts are held.

name: Building or Architectural Landmark
definition: A significant or notable structure, often of historical or cultural importance.

name: Military Leader or Commander
definition: An individual who leads military forces.

name: City or Town
definition: A human settlement smaller than a city but larger than a village.

name: Tank or Armored Vehicle
definition: A heavily armored combat vehicle.

name: Political Affiliation or Party
definition: An association with a political group or ideology.

name: Religious Jurisdiction or Diocese
definition: An administrative district under the supervision of a religious leader.

name: Ethnic or Cultural Group
definition: A community of people sharing common cultural, linguistic, or ancestral traits.

name: Legislation or Law
definition: A formal legal act or statute enacted by a governing body.

name: Language or Dialect
definition: A particular form of a language specific to a region or group.

name: University or College
definition: An institution providing higher education and degrees.

name: Political Term or Concept
definition: A phrase or idea used in political discourse.

name: Play or Theatrical Work
definition: A written dramatic work intended for performance.

name: Chemical Compound or Drug
definition: A substance with a defined chemical composition, often used medicinally.

name: School
definition: An institution for educating children or students.

name: Mountain Range
definition: A series of connected mountains.

name: Amino Acid
definition: An organic compound that combines to form proteins.

name: Highway or Road
definition: A major public road, especially one connecting cities or regions.

name: Game
definition: A structured form of play or sport, usually undertaken for entertainment or competition.

name: Neighborhood or District
definition: A localized community or area within a city or town.

name: Television Series
definition: A serialized television program consisting of multiple episodes.

name: Vehicle Model
definition: A specific model or type of vehicle, including cars, vans, or other transport means.

name: Music Album
definition: A collection of audio recordings issued as a single item on CD, record, or another medium.

name: Media Company or Group
definition: An organization that owns or operates media outlets such as TV channels, radio stations, or publishing houses.

name: Person - Politician
definition: An individual involved in politics, especially one holding or seeking an elected office.

name: Aircraft

name: Sports Player
definition: An individual who participates in a sport, typically as a member of a team.

name: Fungus

name: Railway Facility
definition: A structure or location related to railway operations, such as sheds, stations, or yards.

name: Cartoon or Animated Series

name: Literary Work
definition: A written work, such as a book, novel, or memoir.

name: Person - Musician
definition: An individual who performs or composes music.

name: Geographical Feature - Embankment or Waterfront

name: Weapon

name: Aircraft Model

name: Theater or Performance Venue
definition: A place where live performances such as plays or concerts are held.
